verdict.rationale: The only AI mention is "AI-powered suggestions" used to "hook your audience". That describes recommendations shown to email recipients, not AI-generated insights or suggestions for the user about their own data. The "advanced data insights" item is never described as AI-generated, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
